dialogue_texts: Where has Flandre gone? It seems quieter in here than I expected.
What was that? Whose voice was that?
Just a wayward gap in the space between your archives and reality.
Uhh, who are you? Why are you in the mansion when this is Order territory?
I'm Queen Yukari, and I'm simply here to speak with Flandre.
The Scarlet Devil may be enjoying a day off today, but I'm not going to lead you to her.
In the meantime, my magic will prove you are not welcome!
